ns2:section.sectionText: A supplementary course in derivatives, it will explore individual cases (many of them major disasters) and particular sectors (energy, FX, fixed income). Assumes some basic familiarity with derivatives. We will make extensive use of the Margolis Market Information Lab (MIL) facilities, and several MIL training modules will be presented as part of the course. The course will meet in the Margolis Market Information Lab (1029 BIF). Reserved for MBA and MSF.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to MS: Finance Cost Rec -UIUC or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
